fields.name: createFollowUp
fields.description: Create a draft that follows up the non-openers of a sent engagement. The draft copies the source's campaign, audience and medium and starts on its template; the operator then changes the message and fires it like any draft. Only a sent engagement with non-openers left can be followed up.

args.name: engagementId
args.description: The engagement.

fields.name: fire
fields.description: Fire a draft engagement, which starts its send. It freezes what will be sent, copies the audience into the engagement's members and starts sending to them. Returns immediately with the engagement in PREPARING; the copy and send run in the background.

args.name: engagementId
args.description: The engagement.

args.name: sendJustOne
args.description: Send to the first member only, and leave the rest pending for sendOneMore, sendToMember or sendRest. False by default.

fields.name: saveEngagementDraft
fields.description: Save a draft engagement, new or existing. A draft's or a prepared engagement's parts can be edited. When the audience is refreshed the engagement is prepared (its members built ahead of the send, landing PREPARED); otherwise it stays a DRAFT.

args.name: model
args.description: The draft. Without an id, a new one is created.

fields.name: sendOneMore
fields.description: Send to one more member of a 'send just one' left behind. The engagement stays PARTIALLY_SENT, so the operator can keep sending one at a time - unless that was the last member, when the send completes.

args.name: engagementId
args.description: The engagement.

fields.name: sendRest
fields.description: Send to everyone a 'send just one' left behind. The engagement moves PARTIALLY_SENT -> SENDING and the rest of its members are sent to.

args.name: engagementId
args.description: The engagement.

fields.name: sendToMember
fields.description: Send to one chosen member of a 'send just one' left behind. It is the real engagement, to just that person, and the member must still be pending. The engagement stays PARTIALLY_SENT, unless that was the last member, when the send completes.

args.name: engagementId
args.description: The engagement.

args.name: memberId
args.description: The engagement member to send to. It must still be pending.

fields.name: toggleArchiveEngagement
fields.description: Archive or unarchive an engagement. A send in motion (PREPARING or SENDING) cannot be archived; a draft or a finished send can. Archiving a campaign still hides every engagement under it.

types.name: PayoutTransactionType
types.description: What a payout transaction records.

enumValues.name: APPLICATION_FEE_REFUND
enumValues.description: The payment provider refunded a fee because a charge failed.

enumValues.name: AUTO_DEBIT
enumValues.description: The payment provider took money from the organisation's bank account to clear a negative balance.

enumValues.name: BALANCE_TRANSFER_INBOUND
enumValues.description: Stripe's balance_transfer_inbound - money into the balance. Seen only in Stripe test data.

enumValues.name: DISPUTE
enumValues.description: A customer dispute, refunded outside the platform - the payment needs attention.

enumValues.name: DISPUTE_REVERSAL
enumValues.description: A dispute reversed - the payment is live again but still needs attention.

enumValues.name: OTHER_ADJUSTMENT
enumValues.description: Any other adjustment by the payment provider.

enumValues.name: PAYMENT
enumValues.description: A payment taken from a customer.

enumValues.name: PAYMENT_FAILURE
enumValues.description: A failed or declined payment, with a fee and no money taken.

enumValues.name: PAYMENT_FAILURE_REFUND
enumValues.description: A payment a payout included early, that then failed - in effect a refund.

enumValues.name: PAYMENT_PROVIDER_FEE
enumValues.description: A fee, or a fee discount, the payment provider applied outside a single charge or refund.

enumValues.name: PAYOUT_CANCEL
enumValues.description: The payment provider backed out part or all of a payout at the account owner's request.

enumValues.name: PAYOUT_FAILURE
enumValues.description: The payment provider backed out part or all of a payout.

enumValues.name: REFUND
enumValues.description: A payment reversed, and a refund given.

enumValues.name: REFUND_FAILURE
enumValues.description: A refund that could not be processed - it needs attention.

enumValues.name: RISK_RESERVED_FUNDS
enumValues.description: The payment provider holding money back, or releasing it, as a buffer.

types.name: TransactionType
types.description: What a transaction records against an order line.

enumValues.name: ACCRUE_MOVE
enumValues.description: Part of a move, reported with the transfers. Not written today; older orders may carry it.

enumValues.name: ALLOCATION_OFFSET
enumValues.description: Offsets an allocation's value, so it totals zero.

enumValues.name: ALLOCATION_OFFSET_UNDO
enumValues.description: Takes off an allocation's offset when it is confirmed.

enumValues.name: CANCEL_PACKAGE_PART
enumValues.description: Cancels one part of a package.

enumValues.name: DONOTUSE_SELL_PACKAGE_OFFSET_UNDO
enumValues.description: No longer used; kept for old transactions.

enumValues.name: FORWARD_OFFSET
enumValues.description: Balances an accepted forward in the original order, paid from the transfer to the recipient.

enumValues.name: MOVED
enumValues.description: An order line moved onto this place. Not written today; older orders may carry it.

enumValues.name: MOVED_FROM
enumValues.description: An order line moved off this place. Not written today; older orders may carry it.

enumValues.name: MOVE_OFFSET
enumValues.description: Balances a move, so each order totals out. Not written today; older orders may carry it.

enumValues.name: RECLASS
enumValues.description: Reclass - an order line's price was changed, such as to another price type; this is its new value.

enumValues.name: RECLASS_CANCEL
enumValues.description: Takes off an order line's old value in a reclass.

enumValues.name: RECLASS_OFFSET
enumValues.description: Balances a reclass and its reclass cancel, so the order totals out.

enumValues.name: RESALE_UPLIFT
enumValues.description: What the organisation made on a resale - the resale price less the sale price; negative for a loss.

enumValues.name: RESALE_UPLIFT_OFFSET
enumValues.description: Balances a resale uplift, so a resale's transactions total zero.

enumValues.name: RESERVATION_OFFSET
enumValues.description: Offsets a reservation's value, so it totals zero.

enumValues.name: RESERVATION_OFFSET_UNDO
enumValues.description: Takes off a reservation's offset when it is confirmed.

enumValues.name: SELL_PACKAGE_OFFSET
enumValues.description: Offsets a package sale, so its components and discounts total the package's value.

types.name: __EnumValue
types.description: One possible value for a given Enum. Enum values are unique values, not a placeholder for a string or numeric value. However an Enum value is returned in a JSON response as a string.

types.name: __Field
types.description: Object and Interface types are described by a list of Fields, each of which has a name, potentially a list of arguments, and a return type.

types.name: __InputValue
types.description: Arguments provided to Fields or Directives and the input fields of an InputObject are represented as Input Values which describe their type and optionally a default value.

fields.name: defaultValue
fields.description: A GraphQL-formatted string representing the default value for this input value.

types.name: __Schema
types.description: A GraphQL Schema defines the capabilities of a GraphQL server. It exposes all available types and directives on the server, as well as the entry points for query, mutation, and subscription operations.

fields.name: types
fields.description: A list of all types supported by this server.

fields.name: queryType
fields.description: The type that query operations will be rooted at.

fields.name: mutationType
fields.description: If this server supports mutation, the type that mutation operations will be rooted at.

fields.name: subscriptionType
fields.description: If this server support subscription, the type that subscription operations will be rooted at.

fields.name: directives
fields.description: A list of all directives supported by this server.

types.name: __Type
types.description:
The fundamental unit of any GraphQL Schema is the type. There are many kinds of types in GraphQL as represented by the `__TypeKind` enum.

Depending on the kind of a type, certain fields describe information about that type. Scalar types provide no information beyond a name, description and optional `specifiedByURL`, while Enum types provide their values. Object and Interface types provide the fields they describe. Abstract types, Union and Interface, provide the Object types possible at runtime. List and NonNull types compose other types.

types.name: __TypeKind
types.description: An enum describing what kind of type a given `__Type` is.

enumValues.name: SCALAR
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is a scalar.

enumValues.name: OBJECT
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an object. `fields` and `interfaces` are valid fields.

enumValues.name: INTERFACE
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an interface. `fields`, `interfaces`, and `possibleTypes` are valid fields.

enumValues.name: UNION
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is a union. `possibleTypes` is a valid field.

enumValues.name: ENUM
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an enum. `enumValues` is a valid field.

enumValues.name: INPUT_OBJECT
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an input object. `inputFields` is a valid field.

enumValues.name: LIST
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is a list. `ofType` is a valid field.

enumValues.name: NON_NULL
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is a non-null. `ofType` is a valid field.
